content:
mira: Heads up — CloudNova asked for a canonical IaC pattern for deploying Redwood model-serving stacks to their marketplace offering. Need multi-region + private endpoint + KMS + automated telemetry.
ton y: @mira +1. Do we want a single Terraform module with flags for marketplace, or a set of focused modules (network, kms, infra)?
deepa: I'd vote for composable modules. Marketplace teams prefer small surface area. Also need a sample app that shows canary rollout via traffic-split.
henry: Agree. Also call out the model quantization variants and inference pool sizing in examples. We should include autoscaling policies.
mira: Plan: (a) 3 modules: networking, runtime (autoscaling + model pin), marketplace-integration (billing hooks + manifest). (b) example stacks: dev, prod, private-vpc. (c) docs + tests. Owners: @tony runtime, @deepa infra, me marketplace.
tony: Working on runtime proto. Draft for the module call looks like:
```hcl
module "redwood_runtime" {
  source = "github.com/redwood/inference/terraform//modules/runtime"
  region = var.region
  instance_type = var.instance_type
  model_version = var.model_version
}
```
We should standardize inputs: region, instance_type, model_version, kms_key_arn, enable_private_endpoint
deepa: We need CI smoke tests. My idea: unit test uses localstack + kind cluster? Or just run `terraform plan` + basic `curl` smoke using a mocked env. Prefer minimal external dependencies.
henry: Also add a 'stability' test: deploy small pool, send synthetic traffic, compare 99p latency in the example telemetry. We can script with vegeta.
mira: Timeline: draft PRs by next Wed (3860070000), public sample by EOW. @partner_eng_bot can we schedule partner review 2 weeks from release?
partner_eng_bot: Booked: CloudNova review on 2026-04-10 15:00 UTC. Invite sent to cloud-nova-eng@cloudnova.example.com :calendar: 
tony: Question: marketplace manifest — do we expose prebuilt AMI/container tags for quantized vs fp16? That affects runtime module.
deepa: Yes expose `model_variant` var with allowed = ["fp16", "int8q", "int8q-fast"]. Docs should include expected perf/cost ranges.
mira: I'll draft README sections: deploy flow, rollback, privacy considerations (no logs off by default). Also include a 'partner-readme.md' with legal contact for distro.
henry: Who will own the Terraform registry packaging? we should publish under `redwood/marketplace`.
tony: I'll take packaging + semver policy. Will add changelog generator step in CI.
deepa: :thumbsup: ok assigning issues in ZenHub.
mira: Any blockers?
henry: Need sample data access for smoke tests from CloudNova — pinging their partner contact after standup.
mira: perfect. I'll follow up in #partnerships after the review. thanks all.
